movedBy.speaker: Delphine
movedBy.prompt: So where are we headed?
reply: Kynesgrove. There's an ancient dragon burial near there. If we can get there before it happens, maybe we'll learn how to stop it.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine; A Blade in the Dark stage 47 done

movedBy.speaker: Delphine
movedBy.prompt: What makes you think dragons are coming back to life?
reply: I know they are. I've visited their ancient burial mounds and found them empty.
And I've figured out where the next one will come back to life.
We're going to go there, and you're going to kill that dragon. If we succeed, I'll tell you anything you want to know.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine

movedBy.speaker: Delphine
movedBy.prompt: Why are you looking for a Dragonborn?
reply: We remember what most don't - that the Dragonborn is the ultimate dragonslayer.
You're the only one that can kill a dragon permanently by devouring its soul.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine

movedBy.speaker: Delphine

movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine

movedBy.speaker: Delphine
movedBy.prompt: I just came here for the horn.

movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine; A Blade in the Dark stage 35 not done

movedBy.speaker: Delphine

movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine

startedBy.speaker: Delphine
startedBy.prompt: So how do we get into the Thalmor Embassy?
reply: Hmm, I'm not sure yet. I have a few ideas, but I'll need some time to pull things together...
Meet me back in Riverwood. If I'm not back when you get there, wait for me. I shouldn't be long.
Keep an eye on the sky. This is only going to get worse.
startedBy.source: TIF__01162FB9.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:03B495 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Delphine
startedBy.prompt: What makes you think the Thalmor are bringing dragons back?
reply: Nothing solid. Yet. But my gut tells me it can't be anybody else.
The Empire had captured Ulfric. The war was basically over. Then a dragon attacks, Ulfric escapes, and the war is back on.
And now the dragons are attacking everywhere, indiscriminately. Skyrim is weakened, the Empire is weakened.
Who else gains from that but the Thalmor?

startedBy.speaker: Delphine
startedBy.prompt: Who are you and what do you want with me?
reply: I'm one of the last members of the Blades.
A very long time ago, the Blades were dragonslayers, and we served the Dragonborn, the greatest dragonslayer.
For the last two hundred years, since the last Dragonborn emperor, the Blades have been searching for a purpose.
Now that dragons are coming back, our purpose is clear again. We need to stop them.

firstObjective.text: Meet Delphine in Riverwood or storm the Thalmor Embassy

movedBy.speaker: Delphine
movedBy.prompt: So what's your plan? How do I infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy?
reply: The Thalmor ambassador, Elenwen, regularly throws parties where the rich and connected cozy up to the Thalmor.
I can get you into one of those parties. Once you're inside the embassy, you can get away and find Elenwen's secret files.
I have a contact inside the embassy. He's not up for this kind of high-risk mission, but he can help you.
His name is Malborn. Wood Elf - plenty of reason to hate the Thalmor. You can trust him.
I'll get word for him to meet you in Solitude, at the Winking Skeever -- you know it?
While you're doing that, I'll work on getting you an invitation to Elenwen's little party.
Meet me at the Solitude stables after you've arranged things with Malborn. Any questions?
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Delphine
movedBy.source: TIF__0005F702.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:05F702 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

firstObjective.text: Find out how to defeat Alduin

objective.text: Gain admittance to the Hall of Valor

movedBy.speaker: Stormcloak Soldier
movedBy.prompt: Invisible Walk Away
reply: The World-Eater waits within the mist! Bring word to Shor's hall of our hard fate!
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias LostSoul

movedBy.speaker: Stormcloak Soldier
movedBy.prompt: Yes, it's at the far end of the valley from here.
reply: I saw it fair when first I trod this long-sought path. The pain and fear vanished, dreamlike, and a vision beckoned...
Shor's hall, shimmering across the clouded vale. But quenched was hope by the shrouding mist - my mind is darkened.
I've lost the way and wander blindly.
Hurry! Before Alduin your life devours bring word to Shor's hall of our hard fate!
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias LostSoul
movedBy.source: TIF__0004E9BB.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:04E9BB (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

movedBy.speaker: Stormcloak Soldier
movedBy.prompt: Shor's hall? What's that?
reply: Don't you know? What drew you here? Surely your dreams showed you the way?
The Hall of Valor, where heroes wait to follow Shor to the final battle.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias LostSoul

movedBy.speaker: Tsun
reply: What brings you, wayfarer grim, to wander here, in Sovngarde, souls-end, Shor's gift to honored dead?
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tsun; Sovngarde stage 135 not done

movedBy.speaker: Tsun
movedBy.prompt: I seek entrance to the Hall of Valor.
reply: No shade are you, as usually here passes, but living, you dare the land of the dead.
By what right do you request entry?
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Tsun; Sovngarde stage < 140

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
